# MonitoringPage

The planned SongNodes Pipeline health page: answers "is anything broken right now" with one banner, live connection state, headline figures, scraper and proxy…

`SongNodes.MonitoringPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.MonitoringPage connection="live" incidents={…} totals={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.MonitoringPage" connection="live" incidents="{{…}}" totals="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (MonitoringPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `connection` * | `"live" \| "reconnecting" \| "offline" \| "partial"` | Live-update connection for ConnectionStatus. |
| `incidents` * | `PipelineIncident[]` | Active incidents; the most severe becomes the one Banner, the rest collapse into it. |
| `totals` * | `{ jobsToday: number; failedToday: number; queueLength: number; oldestWaitingSec: number; proxiesHealthy: nu…` | Figure tiles. |
| `scrapers` * | `ScraperHealth[]` | Scraper table rows. |
| `enrichment` | `{ startedAt: string; steps }` | Current enrichment run steps for StagedProgress (EnrichmentStatus per step). |
| `proxies` * | `ProxyHealth[]` | Proxy pool. |
| `reviewQueue` * | `{ autoApproved: number; lowConfidence: number; conflicts: number; unchecked: number }` | Review-queue counts for the Checklist. |
| `errors` * | `{ at: IsoTime; source: string; message: string; action?: ReactNode }[]` | Recent errors, newest first; the first one that needs the person gets ErrorState guidance. |
| `onRunScrapers` * | `() => Promise<void>` | Primary action. |

### PipelineIncident

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` | Bold first sentence. |
| `text` * | `string` | Number or consequence. |

### ScraperHealth

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Scraper name as the source writes it. |
| `kind` * | `string` | Source kind shown under the name. |
| `status` * | `string` | ScraperStatus: idle \| running \| error \| disabled \| circuit_open. |
| `lastSuccessAt` * | `string \| null` | Last successful job; ▲ after 1 h, ✕ after 6 h. |
| `successRate` * | `number[] \| null` | Hourly success rate 0–100 for the last 24 h, oldest first; null when off. |
| `jobsToday` * | `number` | Jobs run today. |
| `nextRunAt` * | `string \| null` | Next scheduled run, null when off. |
